Might be worth quickly discussing the topic of CLs trusting blobs and proofs given by the EL (on `getPayloadV5` and `getBlobsV2`) instead of re-verifying. Discussed (among other things) in this thread: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1389258624064294923 

Status quo seems to be:
- Lighthouse, Nimbus: verify
- Prysm, Teku: trust
- Lodestar: ?

I'd like to suggest or bring up increasing the gas cost of CLZ from 3 to 5/8 - to be a little safer.

I don't have any benchmarks currently. Just increasing the number now so we can finalize the Fusaka spec faster. Double/triple the price seems very reasonable given the gas cost savings that CLZ already brings (note the optimal Solidity implementation of CLZ "uses about 184 gas". We can come back to changing this in Glamsterdam.
I'd like to suggest changing EIP 7825 (tx cap) to the limit specified in EIP 7983 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9984 of 16M; rather than waiting one fork to then nerf it
